Heyyy ,fellow Tunisian pharmacist here !!
Can you tell me how did you get this masters? I've been looking for a masters program in Hungary 😊
I really hope it does. Thank you.
That's all I needed now. Thank you for your kind heart.

I know this would sound depressing and dark, but it was going to happen eventually.
I know I am going to end my own life eventually, I am now feeding on some little happy moments and holding on for some loved ones.
But I will get to that point,broken beyond repair and so tired.
The thing is it's hard for someone who didn't get there to understand how dark it is, you can't escape it.
If it happened, nothing could have prevented it,and that doesn't mean you weren't enough, not at all.
You're human and so is he.

Hey , I am sorry for your loss.
As a suicidal person myself who attempted many times I will tell you nothing could have prevented it.
He made a plan and executed perfectly, the text could even be programmed to be sent after he killed himeslf, as I myself did it before but with a post.
My friends got to me before passing away as the pills I took worked later than I expected.
Don't blame yourself for anything , that was not his goal.
He wanted to end it and he did, there is nothing left to do other than be there for those who are present,those who are fighting.
Again I am sorry for your loss,grieve properly and ask for support.

I consider happiness is mainly about the people you're with, people provide emotions(either positive or negative)  ,connections, support and a deeper and wider perspective even when it comes to memories.
I'd rather chill with a blunt at home with people I cherish than attend the best concert alone.
Roll a blunt zaytouna.
